name: EnquiryKit – Product Enquiry & Request Quote by DominoPress
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
EnquiryKit is a minimalistic and lightweight plugin designed for businesses and wholesalers using WordPress.

The plugin is built to be extremely fast and secure, keeping only the essential features needed for enquiries without bloating your site. It securely routes all submissions directly to the Site Administrator’s email address.

Features

  • Provides a simple [enquirykit_product_enquiry] shortcode to display a secure contact form anywhere.
  • Captures Name, Email, and Message.
  • Zero-configuration required. It just works out of the box.
  • Built with strict WordPress security standards (Nonces, Escaping, Sanitization).

Usage

Place the shortcode anywhere on your pages, posts, or WooCommerce product descriptions:
[enquirykit_product_enquiry]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/enquirykit-product-enquiry directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the [enquirykit_product_enquiry] shortcode to display the form.
  4. Enquiries will be automatically emailed to the admin email address configured in Settings > General.
sections.faq:
Where are the emails sent?

Emails are automatically routed to your site’s default Administration Email Address (configured in Settings > General).

Is the form secure?

Yes! The form strictly utilizes WordPress nonces to prevent CSRF attacks and rigorously sanitizes all data before processing.
